speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. To better understand your condition, please describe the specific characteristics of your flank pain, such as its intensity, whether it radiates to your groin, and if it worsens with movement. Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood, cloudiness, or foul odor?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. Your history of recent sinusitis treated with antibiotics, followed by persistent fever and flank pain, strongly suggests a urinary tract infection that has ascended to the kidneys. Please confirm if you have experienced chills, nausea, or urinary frequency/burning to solidify this clinical picture.
